about_the_game:
Choose your alchemist and fight off hordes of homunculi with potions you create. In this auto-battler survival roguelite, each ingredient you collect has a unique effect which can be combined into any potion you can imagine. Discover absurd synergies and rescue fellow alchemists in your quest to discover the philosopher’s stone.

Collect sulfur when on the move to upgrade your ingredients and potions. Gather mercury while stationary and use it to buy new ingredients. Burn, electrocute, douse, heal, and freeze your way through swarms of unnatural constructs guarding the secrets of Azoth.

Features

  • Custom Potions: Every potion you use to fight enemies or bolster your defenses is brewed from scratch using ingredients you've collected. Each ingredient creates a new effect when combined with a potion.

  • Character Variety: Rescue fellow alchemists to play them in subsequent runs. With over 20 characters each with their own strengths and weaknesses, no two runs will be the same.

  • Quick Runs: Every battle lasts 20 minutes (or shorter).

  • Dual Resource System: Build your alchemist by spending mercury and sulfur. Enemies drop sulfur when you are moving and can be used to upgrade potions and ingredients. Enemies drop mercury when you are stationary and can be used to acquire new ingredients.

  • Horizontal Progression: By unlocking new stages, alchemists, and ingredients; you will always have countless new ways to approach the horrors you'll face while still being able to compare how successful each run was.

  • Auto-Fire: Potions are thrown on an interval and aimed based on their ingredients. Perfect for controllers!
